description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks." The horizontal axis, labeled "Dataset and Metrics," contains nine categorical groups arranged from left to right: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, with the labels rotated diagonally. The vertical axis, labeled "Score (%)," represents values on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 10. The chart features grouped bars, where each category on the horizontal axis contains two side-by-side bars. According to the legend titled "Model," the blue bars represent "LLaMA-3-8B-it" and the orange bars represent "Ours (Iterative RLHF)." Within each group, the blue bar is positioned on the left and the orange bar is on the right. The tallest bars appear in the GSM-8K category, with the blue and orange bars reaching approximately 79 and 80, respectively. The shortest bar is the blue bar in the Chat-Arena-Hard category, measuring approximately 20, while the corresponding orange bar in that category is near 29. The bars do not follow a strict ascending or descending sort order across the categories, and there are no visually emphasized bars through shading, bolding, or annotations.
